messages:
raj: Heads-up — after rolling kernel 6.5.12-rl to us-west1-gpu pool we see P2P negotiated as DISABLED on 3 A100 hosts. NVML reports BAR1 window size 0x0 intermittently. Canary was fine earlier today.

sophie: ouch. which driver/CUDA? did we change anything else in the bundle?

raj: Driver is 535.54 + CUDA 12.1. No config changes aside from kernel. Kernel was rolled from 6.1.45 -> 6.5.12-rl (stable image).

kevin: any logs from dmesg/nvidia-smi?

raj: pasted the snippet below from one affected host (host-a100-17):

```
$ sudo dmesg | tail -n 60
[ 12345.678901] nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: BAR0: mapped 0x0 - reported BAR1 0x0
[ 12345.679012] p2p_peer_access: peer access disabled for 0000:3b:00.0
[ 12345.679102] nv_peer_mem: registering peer memory: failed to init BAR1
```

```
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,p2p_enabled,bar1_size --format=csv
name, p2p_enabled, bar1_size
A100-SXM4-40GB, Disabled, 0x0
```

maria: interesting — BAR1 showing 0x0 is consistent with a kernel PCIe resource negotiation failure. Could be the kernel's PCIe driver tree or an ACPI change.

opsbot: incident created: INC-2026-1145 (priority P2) — tags: p2p, a100, kernel, us-west1.

kevin: quick triage idea — can we repro on a staging host? If it's driver+kernel interaction we should try 6.5.12 + driver 535 and also 6.1 + 535 to isolate kernel.

raj: repro done on staging. 6.5.12 + 535 shows same behavior on 2/5 staging A100 hosts. 6.1.45 + 535 is fine. 6.5.12 + 525 (older driver) also fine. So kernel looks like the root cause.

sophie: are these hosts all the same BIOS/firmware? Any PCIe ACS/ACS override flags set in kernel cmdline?

raj: BIOS versions identical. Kernel cmdline has `pcie_acs_override=downstream` on all nodes — we didn't change that.

maria: could be related to irq frequency or pcie link retraining in 6.5 that changes resource assignment order and triggers a NV driver check that bails out BAR1 allocation. I saw a similar pattern once where link training led to transient 0-size BAR read until a retry.

kevin: mitigation options? We can't afford full rollback of kernel in us-west1 immediately — capacity impacted (~8% of A100 pool).

raj: mitigation we tested: unloading `nvidia` modules then reloading forces re-enumeration and BAR1 returns non-zero most times: `sudo modprobe -r nvidia_uvm nvidia_drm nvidia` then `sudo modprobe nvidia`. Not ideal for prod but workable for live fix on affected hosts.

maria: can we script a graceful node restart of GPU services (cordon + drain + reload modules + uncordon) as a stopgap?

kevin: yes, we have a small automation we can run from the oncall runbook. But if reload fails we need full host reboot. What's success rate?

raj: on staging reload fixed 5/6 attempts. On prod 3/3 fixed so far. We'll run through all 12 affected nodes during off-peak window.

infra-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/p2p-bar1-kernel-issue — checklist updated by raj at 2026-03-18T15:12:00Z

sophie: longer term we should either pin to 6.1 for A100 pools or get kernel vendor/driver team to sign off on 6.5 fixes. Also open a ticket with NVIDIA — driver may need a kernel compatibility patch.

maria: agree. open NV ticket with collected logs: pci configs, dmesg, lspci -vvv, bios tables, and reproduction steps. Ask NVIDIA to look at BAR1 negotiation codepath for 6.5 kernels.

kevin: cost/capacity note — this incident will force ~10% capacity reduction during remediation window. Ops, please check if any large jobs are running and surface high-priority customers.

opsbot: paging: @oncall-ml @sre — 12 A100 nodes in us-west1 affected, estimated remediation window 90-180m if module reload path works.

raj: plan for next 2 hours: 1) run module-reload automation on affected nodes (staggered), 2) gather full NV request bundle, 3) prepare rollback plan for kernel image across pool if reload fails >30% nodes.

kevin: one more datapoint — telemetry shows slight uptick in corrected errors on affected hosts preceding the P2P disable. Could be retrain loop. I'll attach graphs to the NV ticket.

maria: thanks. I'll draft NV ticket. Raj, keep me posted on reload outcomes.

raj: updating: first 4 nodes reloaded, 3 returned healthy, 1 needed full reboot. Continuing.

sophie: nice work. postmortem action item: add a canary that verifies BAR1 != 0 after kernel rollouts for GPU pools.

raj: agreed — adding automated post-rollout check that runs `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=bar1_size --format=csv` on a 10-node canary set and fails the rollout on mismatch.

kevin: and add a metric alert when BAR1 drops to 0x0 across >2 nodes in a region.

opsbot: INC-2026-1145 updated: status=mitigating, impacted_nodes=12, actions=module_reload, nv_ticket=OPEN-123456.

maria: NV ticket created: NV-2026-882 — attached logs + graphs. NV engineer requested kernel dmesg and `setpci -s 3b:00.0 0x10.w` output.

raj: continuing remediation now. Will post final status when all nodes done or if rollback triggered. :white_check_mark:

kevin: thanks everyone. keep chatter here for updates only — we'll lift to incidents if escalation needed. :thumbsup:
